cues: For over a century two pictures of light competed.
Newton said light is a stream of tiny particles, corpuscles.
To explain bending towards the normal, he needed water to pull the particles in, so they would speed up in water.
Huygens said light is a wave, and it bends towards the normal because it slows down in water.
